A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TigerLLM paper, with all ten pages and Appendices A–C available. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original TigerLLM benchmark results in Table 2 and pretraining and finetuning loss curves in Appendix C, Figures 3–4.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains the original benchmark results in Table 2 and training-loss curves in Appendix C, Figures 3–4.

M1.justification: The instruction-generation and filtering procedure, continual pretraining, full finetuning, and 1B/9B model configurations are identical in Sections 3–4 and Appendices A–C.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Bangla-TextBook and Bangla-Instruct training data and the same six evaluation benchmarks in Table 2. Appendix A's seed-task categories and volunteer population are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same ten comparators, including GPT3.5, Gemini-Flash1.5, GPT4o-mini, and the same multilingual and Bangla-specific models. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: The Pass@1 metric, model configurations, data counts, training budgets, and all stated settings in Section 4 and Appendix B are unchanged. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains identical training-loss curves. Neither version reports additional ablations, sensitivity tests, robustness evaluations, error analyses, or case studies.

E5.justification: Tables 4–5 retain seed 42. Neither version reports confidence intervals, significance tests, or explicit repeated-run counts for the benchmark results; uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: Every Table 2 score is identical, including TigerLLM (9B)'s 0.72 on MMLU-bn and 0.68 on BanglaRQA. Appendix C's loss curves and the textual findings also match.

T1.justification: The task-generation notation in Section 3 and filtering definitions, thresholds, and acceptance equation in Appendix A.3 are identical. Neither version contains additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about the two datasets, TigerLLM models, benchmark superiority, and claimed 30–55% performance improvements.

C2.justification: The interpretations emphasizing data quality, Appendix C's training explanations, and limitations concerning educational-domain coverage, instruction diversity, and model scale are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices A–B retain identical curation details, filtering thresholds, hardware, training times, and hyperparameters. Resource-access statements and link targets are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, comparison with earlier Bangla LLM initiatives, and research positioning are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv:2503.10995v1, 14 Mar 2025, to arXiv:2503.10995v2, 16 May 2025. All paper prose, headings, and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4, Tables 1–5, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages match exactly outside the first-page version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The only visible revision is the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, explanations, and displays—including all appendices—are identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
